brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: One drawer at the corner of a cell
requirements.evidence: No drawer socket is offered on the current build (piece:0,0,0;half-e and piece:1,0,0;half-w) and in all test configurations: find_sockets drawer returned total 0 even with a half-e/half-w present, and after building a full ring of 6 neighbours around 0,0,0;half-e. Configurator note: drawer sits on the cut face of a half base. Its placement is centred on the cut face (mid-edge to mid-edge), not at a hex corner, so it is never offered at a junction.

requirements.requirement: One spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching the drawer
requirements.evidence: No spike socket at that corner in the current 2-piece build. Spike requires three bases around one junction (find_sockets spike = 0 with 2 pieces, =6 with a 6-around-1 ring). Even when a spike was available (s102 at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 touching half-e 0,0,0) no drawer was offered there, so the configurator enforces different locations: spike at a 3-way junction, drawer on a cut-face midpoint. They cannot share the same corner and touch.

finish.summary: Built a test base ring (half-e at 0,0,0 plus up to 6 neighbours) to expose spikes, and reduced to the minimal 2 half-bases (piece:0,0,0;half-e and piece:1,0,0;half-w). In every case find_sockets offered spikes only where three bases meet at a junction, and never offered a drawer (total 0) - drawer sits centred on a half-base cut face (edge-midpoint to edge-midpoint), not at a corner. The configurator therefore blocks co-location at the same corner. With current build: 2 pieces, no drawer, no spike, meshClash clear, LOOSE_BODY warning only. Requirement cannot be met within placement rules.
